interpreterSource.note: The uploaded interpreter was a bare cargo build, which bakes machine paths into the wasm, so its hash cannot be rebuilt elsewhere. A bare build of this commit on the deploying machine gives exactly wasmHashes.interpreter (checked 2026-09-25). build-wasm.sh on the same source under Linux (rust:1.97.1, aarch64, and CI on x86_64) gives reproducibleWasmSha256, which CI rebuilds from main and compares. macOS builds a different hash from the same source, so only a Linux build is comparable.

note: Grammar 6 and the grants-as-data adapter. The adapter salt is v2 because a Prime that already activated v1 has a contract at the v1 address and a different code hash cannot take its place.
